en.summary: The 2026 budget assumes 5% growth and the government expects the economy to reach GEL 114bn in 2026 (2025 growth: 7.5%). ADB and World Bank loans fund the Tbilisi bypass, Trans-Caspian (Middle) Corridor rail and roads, and rural water systems.
